title: with_polymorphic returns AliasedClass[Type[Model]] instead of AliasedClass[Model]

labels.name: near-term release
labels.description: addition to the milestone which indicates this should be in a near-term release

body:
### Ensure stubs packages are not installed

- [X] No sqlalchemy stub packages is installed (both `sqlalchemy-stubs` and `sqlalchemy2-stubs` are not compatible with v2)

### Verify if the api is typed

- [X] The api is not in a module listed in [#6810](https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/issues/6810) so it should pass type checking

### Describe the typing issue

If you use `with_polymorphic`, the created object gets the type `AliasedClass[Type[ORMModel]]`. This propagates to the objects retrieved from the database. They should have the type `Sequence[ORMModel]`. Instead they have the type `Sequence[Type[ORMModel]]`.

### To Reproduce

```python
from typing import Sequence

from sqlalchemy import create_engine, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import (
    DeclarativeBase,
    Mapped,
    Session,
    mapped_column,
    with_polymorphic,
)


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    ...


class Message(Base):
    __tablename__ = "message"
    __mapper_args__ = {
        "polymorphic_on": "message_type",
        "polymorphic_identity": __tablename__,
    }
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    text: Mapped[str]
    message_type: Mapped[str]


class UserComment(Message):
    __mapper_args__ = {
        "polymorphic_identity": "user_comment",
    }
    username: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(nullable=True)


engine = create_engine("postgresql+psycopg2://scott:tiger@localhost/")


def get_messages() -> Sequence[Message]:
    with Session(engine) as session:
        message_query = select(Message)

        # mypy detects type: Sequence[Message]
        # => everything fine
        return session.scalars(message_query).all()


def get_poly_messages() -> Sequence[Message]:
    with Session(engine) as session:
        # mypy detects type: AliasedClass[Type[Message]]
        PolymorphicMessage = with_polymorphic(Message, (UserComment,))

        poly_query = select(PolymorphicMessage)

        # mypy detects type: Sequence[Type[Message]]
        # => conflict with function return type
        return session.scalars(poly_query).all()
```


### Error

```
example.py:56: error: Incompatible return value type (got "Sequence[Type[Message]]", expected "Sequence[Message]")  [return-value]
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 1 source file)
``` 

### Versions

- OS: Fedora 37
- Python: 3.11.1
- SQLAlchemy: 2.0.4
- Type checker: mypy 1.0.1
